title: Testing Orthogonality of Two Vectors
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether the vectors a = <2, -3, 4> and b = <6, 8, 3> are orthogonal.

steps.title: Evaluate Inner Product
steps.explanation: Compute the sum of component products.
steps.why: Checking the vanishing of the dot product.

steps.title: State Conclusion
steps.explanation: Since the dot product is exactly 0, the vectors meet at a 90 degree angle.
